title: Mount Rinjani From Above, Indonesia
description: Looking across the outer caldera of Mount Rinjani, the turquoise Segara Anak crater lake fills the lower bowl, a new volcanic cone rising from its centre, steep switchback trails visible on the inner caldera wall under crisp high-altitude daylight. The scale of the caldera from above is why the article recommends two nights in Sembalun rather than one before the climb. Rinjani crater lake, Lombok volcano hike, Mount Rinjani trek.
